run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run under the same persistent hard egress block as prior runs: the session network policy denies all direct HTTPS to buyer tender hosts (WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm again returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND this run), so no buyer-originated detail page, RSS/JSON feed, API or tender document could be opened and every captured tender is headline-level only. Tier 1 was swept via WebSearch snapshots across AusTender/DFAT, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/VendorPanel (Qld), Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders. As in recent runs, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders were by far the richest live sources; the larger portals (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS) returned mostly stale or framework/demo snapshots (buy.nsw now redirects eTendering to the 'buy.nsw' Opportunities list; Tenders SA search was again partly hijacked by South African results). Seventeen prior opportunities were carried forward; nine of them (the NT QTOL December-closing tenders plus ACT 52652-RFT-002) were explicitly re-confirmed still open in this run's snapshots, the rest carried forward without live re-verification. Two genuinely new opportunities were captured: ACT 39215-RFT-400 (City and Environment Directorate construction/landscaping RFT, released 16 Nov 2026, closing 11 Dec 2026, UNSPSC 72000000/72102902) and NT QTOL T26-1326 (Victoria Highway consultancy, Katherine Region, closing 13 Jan 2027). Two data corrections: the Canberra Health Services medical-equipment RFT carries ID 30995-RFT-420 (prior run's 'PICH0008972' was a mis-read), and the NT fire-detection tender is ID T26-1304. Tier 2 (universities, Sydney/Melbourne/SA Water, NBN, Australia Post, Transgrid, Ausgrid) was sampled — no publicly-visible open opportunity with a current closing date; Melbourne Water's Field Services Panel RFT (Zycus) was flagged imminent. Tier 3 (mandatory): SAP Ariba Discovery and major buyers BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue were queried; all open RFx remain login-gated or visible only via aggregators, so no corporate tender was captured and the portals are recorded in discovered_sources. Two new sources found: Melbourne Water's Zycus supplier portal and Energy Queensland's SAP Ariba supplier portal.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK (unchanged, re-tested this run): the session network policy denies all direct HTTPS to buyer tender hosts. WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm returned getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, matching every prior run, so no buyer-originated detail page, RSS/JSON feed, API or tender document could be opened. Every tender this run is headline-level only; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, contacts and most commercial fields are null. Restoring full discovery and deliverables extraction requires allowing the Tier 1/2/3 tender hosts in the session's network settings.

Tier 1: AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/VendorPanel (Qld), Tenders WA, Tenders SA and Tenders Tasmania could only be read through cached WebSearch snapshots, many stale (Buying for Victoria snapshots still showed late-October closing dates; buy.nsw returned mostly demo-template pages). Newly-published (last 24-48h) listings on those portals are very likely under-captured. NT QTOL and ACT Tenders were the usable exceptions this run.

Tenders SA: WebSearch for the South Australian portal was again partly hijacked by South African ('Tenders SA') results; the SA listings that did surface (contracts.sa.gov.au / procurement.sa.gov.au) had September/October closing dates. No current SA Government opportunity could be captured this run. Deferred / needs direct portal access.

NT QTOL T26-1326 (Victoria Highway consultancy) and ACT 39215-RFT-400 were captured at headline level from buyer-originated snapshots, but their detail pages/documents could not be opened; scope, deliverables and (for T26-1326) the exact closing time remain unverified. Related NT Victoria Highway pavement-design packages (123-130km, 136-146km) appeared only via aggregator australiantenders.com.au and were deliberately NOT captured as tenders (buyer-source detail unavailable).

Tier 2 (universities, Sydney Water, SA Water, Melbourne Water, NBN Co, Australia Post, Transgrid, Ausgrid): sampled, but no publicly-visible open opportunity with a current (Nov/Dec 2026) closing date was found — these route tendering through SAP Ariba, Zycus, their own portals, or had already-closed EOIs. Melbourne Water's Field Services Panel RFT (Zycus) was flagged 'coming soon' but no open-date/closing-date was published. Captured as discovered_sources context only.

Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery and major buyers BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside): queried as mandatory; all open RFx are login-gated or only visible via aggregators/ICN Gateway. No authenticated session is available, so no corporate opportunity was publicly visible and none was fabricated. Portals recorded in discovered_sources.
Tier 3 invitation-only RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs sent directly to shortlisted/panel suppliers) remain out of scope and undiscoverable by design.

Carried-forward opportunities NOT individually re-verified against the live portals this run (egress block): DFAT PNG ENABLE (closing 2026-12-01), Kwinana Bulk Jetty EOI (2026-12-23), NT vehicle-rental T26 (2026-12-08), Power and Water RFT0763 (2026-12-11), Defence DSARC alternate-energy, WA FPC plantation RFP, CSIRO RFT2026031, and both Brisbane City Council RFx. All are believed still open but their status/closing dates were carried from prior runs, not reconfirmed this run.
CSIRO RFT CSIRORFT2026031, the WA FPC plantation RFP and the Defence DSARC managing-contractor ATM have no publicly-visible closing date in the announcement (set in tender documents); left null.
recommended_seed_additions: Melbourne Water Zycus supplier portal (melbournewater.com.au building-and-works / contractor information) — buyer-originated GBE e-sourcing on the Zycus platform (not Ariba/VendorPanel); Field Services Panel RFT runs here. High confidence; register a supplier account for authenticated reads.

Energy Queensland supplier portal (energyq.com.au/suppliers) — Qld government-owned electricity GBE (Energex/Ergon) sourcing via SAP Ariba; pivot point to sibling energy-sector buyers on Ariba. High confidence.

australiantenders.com.au as a DISCOVERY SIGNAL only (aggregator, not source of truth) — repeatedly surfaces NT/SA buyer tender IDs (e.g. Victoria Highway pavement packages) before the buyer portals are reachable; use to spot new buyer tender IDs, then pivot to QTOL/the buyer source. Do not record its listings as confirmed opportunities.

utilitymagazine.com.au 'open tenders and opportunities' — trade-press signpost that surfaces imminent water/energy GBE RFTs (e.g. Melbourne Water Field Services Panel on Zycus); discovery signal for Tier 2 utility procurement.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Known Tier 1 portal; WA Government media statements/announcements pointed to current Tenders WA listings (Kwinana Bulk Jetty EOI, FPC plantation RFP).
discovered_sources.notes: Live search pages not retrievable; WA Government announcements are a useful parallel discovery feed for Tenders WA items.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Known Tier 2 platform; sampled this run for council RFQs. Queensland Procurement Solution tender documents are migrating to VendorPanel.
discovered_sources.notes: Most councils route public tenders here and/or to their own sites.

discovered_sources.source_name: SAP Business Network Discovery / SAP Ariba Discovery
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Mandatory Tier 3 check; public posting board again requires a free supplier login to view open Australian RFx.
discovered_sources.notes: No publicly-visible Australian corporate RFx without an authenticated session. Many AU buyers (Sydney Water, Rio Tinto, South32, Coles) route sourcing through Ariba. No corporate tender fabricated.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Recurred as the buyer-originated work-package gateway for major projects this run (Chevron Australia, BHP Port Debottlenecking, Perth Airport, NT Logistics & Infrastructure).
discovered_sources.notes: Buyer-originated project/work-package gateway for major capital projects; registration gives full package detail.

discovered_sources.source_name: Melbourne Water — Zycus supplier portal (Field Services Panel RFT)
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Tier 2 GBE sweep — a Melbourne Water notice flagged an imminent open RFT for renewal of its Field Services Panel (FSP), with responses lodged through the Zycus portal requiring supplier self-registration. First time Zycus has been recorded as a buyer-originated e-sourcing platform for this routine.
discovered_sources.notes: Buyer-originated GBE procurement running on Zycus (not Ariba/VendorPanel). Individual opportunities are registration-gated; the Field Services Panel RFT was flagged 'coming soon' (annual procurement plan estimated release 30 Jun 2026, since slipped). Register a supplier account to read full opportunity detail in an authenticated run.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Tier 3 / e-sourcing platform pivot off the SAP Ariba Discovery sweep — Energy Queensland (Qld government-owned electricity GBE, Energex/Ergon) runs supplier sourcing (RFQ/RFT) through SAP Ariba. Sibling-buyer discovery alongside Endeavour Energy and PanAust on the same platform.
discovered_sources.notes: Buyer-originated GBE sourcing on SAP Ariba; opportunities are registration-gated behind the Ariba Business Network. Captured as a portal; no publicly-visible open opportunity could be read without an authenticated session.
